kill_switch_route_mode.description: When true, hides the 'Walk to a destination' CTA on the Nearby tab so Route Mode can be disabled without a release. Currently ON (Route Mode hidden) for everyone except the Admin audience, which receives 'false' via rollout_1 at 100%.

kill_switch_reporting.description: When true, hides the 'Report a missing postbox' and 'Report wrong cypher' entry points app-wide so problem-reporting can be disabled without a release.

james_welcome_variant.description: Postman James's first-launch line variant. 'classic' = the shipped copy; 'cheeky' = the A/B variant. Other values fall back to 'classic'.

maintenance_mode.description: When true, flips the app into read-only mode: a banner shows and every write entry-point (claim, report, friends, settings) refuses with a toast. Emergency kill switch for backend maintenance.

maintenance_message.description: Admin-authored banner copy shown while maintenance_mode is on. Defaults to the in-app copy in RemoteConfigService.defaultMaintenanceMessage. Postman James voice; no em-dashes.

claim_radius_meters.description: Claim radius in metres. Must start equal to the code default (30). Values outside the [10, 100] safety band are ignored; client and server fall back to 30. Publish this key to the SERVER template too (functions/src/_config.ts).

points_by_monarch.description: Per-cypher point overrides. Must start equal to the code default (RemoteConfigService.defaultPointsByMonarchJson). Values outside [1, 50] and unknown keys are ignored; omitted monarchs keep their hard-coded value. Publish to the SERVER template too.

kill_switch_offline_claims.description: v1.5 offline play: emergency kill switch for offline claim capture + flush. The server (functions/src/_config.ts) enforces its own copy on flushOfflineClaims; this hides the client affordances. Publish to the SERVER template too.

offline_claim_grace_hours.description: v1.5 offline play: how long a banked offline capture stays flushable, in hours. Must start equal to the code default (36). Values outside the [1, 168] safety band are ignored; client and server fall back to 36. Publish to the SERVER template too.

max_offline_claims_per_day.description: v1.5 offline play: per-user daily cap on flushed offline claims. Must start equal to the code default (30). Values outside the [1, 200] safety band are ignored; client and server fall back to 30. Publish to the SERVER template too.

version.description: Postbox Game CLIENT template: kill switches, James welcome variant, maintenance mode + message, and the v1.4 balance pair. Defaults mirror RemoteConfigService.defaults. The balance pair also needs publishing to the server template.
